name: Kothalipi
description:
Kothalipi adds dictation to GNOME Shell using OpenAI’s Whisper speech recognition model. It records from your microphone, transcribes locally on your machine, and copies the text to your clipboard. It can also read selected text aloud with the Kokoro voice model. It requires a companion D-Bus service, installed separately (see the instructions on GitHub).

This extension accesses the clipboard to copy transcribed text, and reads the selected or copied text when you ask it to read aloud.

Kothalipi is a fork of Speech2Text by Kaveh Tehrani (https://github.com/kavehtehrani/speech2text-extension).
